_help: Source images for the in-game photos and VHS tape backgrounds.
Put an image (jpg/png/webp, any size) at assets_src/photos/<slot>.* or assets_src/tapes/<slot>.* and run: npm run photos
No file for a slot = the procedural (drawn) version is used.
crop:  [centerX, centerY, zoom]  — 4:3 crop around a point given as fractions of the source image; zoom > 1 crops tighter.
grade: bright, sat, contrast (1 = unchanged), warm (-0.2..0.2), night (true = blue night conversion), keepLights (night: keep bright windows/lamps, default true).
flash: [x, y, radius] — on-camera flash falloff, fractions of the output frame.
overlays: drawn on top, coordinates are fractions of the OUTPUT frame (after cropping).
figure {x, feet, h, color}      tall faceless figure
ghost  {x, feet, h, alpha}      translucent person
window_man {x, y, w, h}         head-and-shoulders silhouette inside a lit window
moon_child {x, feet, h}         small child in a crescent-moon costume
spot {x, y, r, alpha}           stage spotlight
Set "overlays": [] if your image already shows what the story needs.
Tape points (tapes.*.points) are fractions of the 320x240 tape frame and are written to src/assets/tapes/points.js.
source: "other_slot" reuses another slot's image (ch12_staff_2003_b = same staff photo + the tall figure).
style: "vhs" = paused-tape look (scanlines, heavy noise) with an "osd" timestamp instead of a camera date stamp.
